classes.name: Book
classes.label: 書籍
classes.comment: Illustrated introductory labor-affairs title such as 図解労務入門 100のツボ.

classes.name: Person
classes.label: 人物
classes.comment: Author, co-author, practitioner, worker, or manager.

classes.name: Organization
classes.label: 組織
classes.comment: Enterprise, workplace, union, or labor-standards office.

classes.name: HumanResources
classes.label: 人事
classes.comment: Domain of making people thrive in order to accomplish things (人を生かして事をなす).

classes.name: LaborAffairs
classes.label: 労務
classes.comment: Defensive HR that fulfills labor obligations, protects workers, and underpins livelihood, order, and humanity of the firm.

classes.name: TalentManagement
classes.label: 人材マネジメント
classes.comment: Offensive HR that preferentially invests in selected talent for results.

classes.name: Worker
classes.label: 労働者
classes.comment: Person who provides labor and maintains internal order.

classes.name: Employer
classes.label: 使用者
classes.comment: Enterprise obliged to protect workers under law.

classes.name: LaborObligation
classes.label: 労働上の義務
classes.comment: Mutual duties arising in labor: protection by the enterprise; labor and order by the worker.

classes.name: ConstituentElement
classes.label: 労務の構成要素
classes.comment: One of six elements: rules, hours and pay, life and health, employment, labor-management relations, labor-affairs system.

classes.name: EmploymentSystem
classes.label: 雇用システム
classes.comment: Society-wide employment model (membership-type or job-type).

classes.name: MembershipTypeEmployment
classes.label: メンバーシップ型雇用
classes.comment: Japanese model: mass new-graduate hiring, unlimited duties and location, long-term security, strict dismissal rules.

classes.name: JobTypeEmployment
classes.label: ジョブ型雇用
classes.comment: Post-defined employment with limited duties, consent for transfers, and higher mobility.

classes.name: LaborRole
classes.label: 労務の役割
classes.comment: Holon role in labor affairs: OE, RM, or ST.

classes.name: OperationExcellence
classes.label: OE
classes.comment: Foundational role: accurate timely processes (attendance, payroll, insurance, join/leave).

classes.name: RuleMaster
classes.label: RM
classes.comment: Central role: interpret labor law, work rules, and contracts; start from 就業規則に照らす.

classes.name: Strategist
classes.label: ST
classes.comment: Transformer of working styles and rules using macro trends and Pain/Gain design.

classes.name: LegalInstrument
classes.label: 法的規範
classes.comment: Norm in the labor-law pyramid from Constitution down to guidelines.

classes.name: WorkRules
classes.label: 就業規則
classes.comment: Workplace-wide wage, hours and conditions with legal normative force; basis of labor judgments.

classes.name: LaborLaw
classes.label: 労働法
classes.comment: Collective name for statutes protecting unequal worker–employer relations (public and private law).

classes.name: LaborContract
classes.label: 個別労働契約
classes.comment: Contract with a single worker; cannot undercut work-rule minimums.

classes.name: CollectiveAgreement
classes.label: 労働協約
classes.comment: Union–employer agreement applying to union members.

classes.name: LaborManagementAgreement
classes.label: 労使協定
classes.comment: Workplace agreement such as a 36 Agreement; distinct from 労働協約.

classes.name: WorkingHours
classes.label: 労働時間
classes.comment: Time under employer command and supervision, including implicit overtime.

classes.name: HolidayOrLeave
classes.label: 休日・休暇
classes.comment: 休日 (no labor obligation) versus 休暇 (exemption from a scheduled workday), including annual paid leave.

classes.name: Wage
classes.label: 賃金
classes.comment: Compensation subject to Art. 24 principles, minimum wage, and premium rates.

classes.name: WorkStyle
classes.label: 働き方
classes.comment: Flexible or hybrid (Workstyle 3.0) patterns of time, place, and affiliation.

classes.name: HistoricalEra
classes.label: 歴史的時期
classes.comment: Pre-war, wartime, post-war, high-growth, or modern period of Japanese labor.

properties.name: authoredBy
properties.label: 著者
properties.comment: Primary or co-author of the book.

properties.name: hasConstituentElement
properties.label: 構成要素を持つ
properties.comment: Links 労務 to rules, hours/pay, life/health, employment, labor-management relations, or labor-affairs system.

properties.name: complementaryTo
properties.label: 相互補完
properties.comment: Neither 労務 nor talent management alone constitutes 人事.

properties.name: protects
properties.label: 保護する
properties.comment: Enterprise duty to protect workers under law.

properties.name: providesLabor
properties.label: 労働を提供する
properties.comment: Worker obligation to provide labor and keep order.

properties.name: hasLaborRole
properties.label: 労務役割を持つ
properties.comment: Practitioner role OE, RM, or ST; growth via 深化 or 進化.

properties.name: transcendsAndIncludes
properties.label: 超えて含む
properties.comment: Holon nesting: ST includes RM includes OE; without OE everything collapses.

properties.name: employsUnder
properties.label: 雇用システムで雇用する
properties.comment: Membership-type or job-type practice, including work rules and contracts.

properties.name: governedBy
properties.label: 規律される
properties.comment: Subject to constitution, statutes, work rules, agreements, or contracts.

properties.name: hasHigherNorm
properties.label: 上位規範
properties.comment: Hierarchy: 法令 → 労働協約 → 労使協定/就業規則 → 個別労働契約.

properties.name: hasNormativeForce
properties.label: 法的規範性
properties.comment: Work rules apply even without individual knowledge or consent.

properties.name: overwritesContract
properties.label: 最低基準効
properties.comment: Contract terms below work-rule standards are invalid in that part.

properties.name: requiresAgreement
properties.label: 協定を要する
properties.comment: Overtime or statutory holiday work requires a 36 Agreement.

properties.name: commandedTime
properties.label: 指揮命令下の時間
properties.comment: Hours the worker is placed under employer supervision.

properties.name: paidAs
properties.label: 対価として支払われる
properties.comment: Hours, overtime, night, holiday, and leave convert to wage and premiums.

properties.name: evolvesWith
properties.label: 時代とともに進化する
properties.comment: Meaning of living standards and 労務 change from post-war poverty to diversified COVID-era values.

properties.name: supportsWorkStyle
properties.label: 働き方を支える
properties.comment: Telework, side jobs, and hybrid career (Workstyle 3.0) grounded in company philosophy.

properties.name: catchphrase
properties.label: ツボ・標語
properties.comment: Key teaching such as 先手を打つ or 就業規則に照らす.
